description: This file implements ubus (micro bus) support for hostapd, including functions for managing ubus connections, handling events, managing BSS interfaces, and interacting with clients and neighbor reports within the hostapd Wi-Fi access point software.

methods.name: get_hapd_from_object
methods.description: Inline function to retrieve hostapd data structure from ubus object.

methods.name: hostapd_ubus_init
methods.description: Initializes ubus context and registers connection lost callback.

methods.name: hostapd_ubus_ref_inc
methods.description: Increments reference count for ubus context.

methods.name: hostapd_ubus_ref_dec
methods.description: Decrements reference count and frees ubus context if zero.

methods.name: hostapd_ubus_add_bss
methods.description: Adds a new ubus object for a hostapd BSS interface.

methods.name: hostapd_ubus_free_bss
methods.description: Removes and frees ubus object for a hostapd BSS interface.

methods.name: hostapd_ubus_handle_event
methods.description: Handles ubus events such as probe, auth, and assoc requests, and sends notifications.

methods.name: hostapd_ubus_notify
methods.description: Sends a notification to ubus subscribers about a specific event.
